subject: Coord: Narrow quiet window for exec demo across US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@globex.com>, Michael Tan <michael.t@globex.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: executive demo — finding a quiet window across US/EU/APAC

Hi Alice / Michael —

Thanks again for the interest in a short executive-level demo of Redwood Inference. We know this will need all three of your leads (CTO, Head of ML, Product) and our two execs (Jonas, Mina) on the call. To avoid back-and-forth, attaching a simple timezone matrix and a soft availability ics so we can converge quickly.

High-level ask: can we identify a single 45–60 minute "quiet window" in September where all execs can attend? We know DST fiddles make the usual US-morning / EU-evening / APAC-late-night trade-offs tricky.

Initial constraints from our side:
- Jonas (CTO) prefers 13:00–17:00 UTC on weekdays (to avoid late APAC hours).
- Mina (Head of Product) can do 14:00–18:00 UTC most weekdays but wants to avoid Fridays.
- Karthik (Solutions lead) will support the demo but can be flexible.

Can you share the Globex executives' core availability blocks (best/worst times) and whether any of you have travel on the week of Sep 20? If helpful, here are two candidate windows that look promising when converted:

Option A: 15:00–16:00 UTC (US morning west coast 08:00–09:00 PDT; EU 16:00–17:00 BST/CET; APAC next-day 00:00–01:00 AEST)
Option B: 07:00–08:00 UTC (US late-night east coast 03:00–04:00 EDT; EU 08:00–09:00 CET; APAC 15:00–16:00 AEST)

Neither is perfect; Option A pushes APAC late but is friendlier to US mornings. Option B is kinder to APAC but painful for US East. If you can reply with preferred windows and any absolute no-go times, I'll consolidate and propose the final slot.

Attachments: timezone_matrix.csv (simple grid), exec_availability.ics (our internal placeholder)

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Note: we will propose concrete dates after we confirm which week works for you.

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@globex.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tan <michael.t@globex.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 17:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordination: executive demo — finding a quiet window across US/EU/APAC

Thanks, Mina —

Appreciate the tidy matrix. Quick notes from our side:
- Our CTO will be traveling the week of Sep 13–17 (on a customer trip) and has limited pockets; the week of Sep 20 looks much better.
- Michael (Head of ML) and our Product lead are both flexible but prefer not to be later than 17:30 BST on demo days.
- Timezone reality: our APAC execs (Sydney) started DST earlier this year, and AUS DST makes the "same UTC" map shift by an hour vs last quarter — so the AEST conversions in your sheet are off by +1 during the Sep window.

Of your two options, Option A (15:00–16:00 UTC) is better for our EU folks but will require our Sydney exec to be on a late call (~02:00 local) if we pick an early date — doable but only for top-level demos. Option B is rough for our US East exec (they would be in the middle of the night).

Proposal: target the week of Sep 20, aim for Option A but try to shift to 14:30–15:30 UTC so Sydney is 01:30–02:30 (still late) and Europe stays within business hours. If Jonas/Mina can push to 14:30/15:30 UTC, we can make it work without forcing US East into 03:00.

I'm attaching a short confirmation doc with our "absolute no-go" times and a suggested one-week window (week of Sep 20).

—Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Sales, Globex Corp
alice.chen@globex.com | +44 20 7946 0123

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: executive demo — finding a quiet window across US/EU/APAC

Appreciate the clarity, Alice — good catch on the DST shift for AU. I updated the matrix and ran a quick check with Jonas.

Concrete narrowed ask:
- Week of Sep 20 is confirmed as the target.
- Proposed final candidate windows (all UTC):
  1) 14:30–15:30 UTC (best balance) — converts to 07:30–08:30 PDT (US West), 15:30–16:30 CEST (EU), 01:30–02:30 AEST (APAC)
  2) 15:00–16:00 UTC (fallback) — converts to 08:00–09:00 PDT, 16:00–17:00 CEST, 02:00–03:00 AEST

Jonas asked for one additional constraint: if we pick 14:30–15:30 UTC, he can commit but requests we keep the agenda to 45 minutes and avoid a long Q&A block after 30 minutes so he can sign off and leave for another meeting.

Action items:
- Alice / Michael: confirm whether 14:30–15:30 UTC on any day Mon–Thu of week Sep 20 works for your CTO / Head of ML / Product. If you can give two preferred days, we'll lock the earliest one.
- If Globex prefers 15:00–16:00 UTC instead, tell us which day — we can do either but note APAC exec will be later.

I'll hold provisional blocked time on our side and will wait for your confirmation.

Thanks —
Mina
